ghostCar.title: Ghost Car (Autonomous Car)
ghostCar.description: Program the Ghost Car's speed directly on the Carrera Control Unit, not through RaceHubOS.
ghostCar.step1: Stop the race. With the CU powered on, leave only the intended Ghost Car on the track.
ghostCar.step2: Press CODE on the CU twice, then press the controller's lane-change button once.
ghostCar.step3: Wait until only the centre LED on the CU is lit again.
ghostCar.step4: Accelerate to a safe lap speed and press the lane-change button again to save it.
ghostCar.limitation: RaceHubOS cannot yet confirm Ghost programming. Ghost and Pace Car laps are excluded from driver scoring. The Pace Car is a separate mode.
